entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly help with that. To get started, could I have your name and order number?
Sarah Miller. The order number is VF88602.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Performance Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item?
I see. And is it a technical fault with the jersey, or more of a preference issue with the fit?
It's just too tight. I don't like it.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear the fit wasn't right. Were you hoping to exchange it for a different size, or would you prefer a refund?
Just a refund. I'm over it.

No problem at all. Let me just confirm the return eligibility here. I see it was delivered 63 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days for a return on standard items, so you are well within the window. I can process this for you right now.
Fine. About time something was simple.

I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply print that out, attach it to the return package with the jersey, and you can drop it off at any local post office.
Whatever. I guess I have to do all the work.
Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you have a better rest of your day.
